entities.name: William J. Cabaniss
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: William Jelks Cabaniss Jr. was an American politician and diplomat who served as a member of both chambers of the Alabama Legislature and U.S. Ambassador to the Czech Republic in the George W. Bush administration.
